_meta.purpose: Documents the real Tally 'X2Beta' e-invoice import template columns and how amazonB2BProcessor.js / amazonB2CProcessor.js derive each one. Verified against the accountant's own reference file ('Amazon B2B& B2C & STR Sales Working-April 2026.xlsx', sheet 'Excel to tally', 108 columns) — row-by-row math confirmed against real sample rows.
_meta.superseded_note: An earlier version of this doc described a different, incorrect 76-column layout based on a garbled paste. That version was wrong and has been fully replaced.
_meta.source_of_truth: The actual code in amazonB2BProcessor.js / amazonB2CProcessor.js (STEP 10) is authoritative; this file is a companion explanation, kept in sync manually.
known_gaps: The Name/Address/State/Country/PIN/Place of Supply/GST Type/GSTIN ledger-master block (3 repeated blocks, ~25 columns) is left blank in both processors. It doesn't correlate with Seller Gstin, buyer GSTIN, or any per-row field checked against the reference file — user confirmed leaving it blank pending a real source.

B2C's Vch No/Ref No reuse the existing 'Final Invoice No.' field rather than the reference file's own AMZ-{ShipToStateCode}-{rank} series, since that needs a per-Ship-To-State short code the Ledger Master upload doesn't currently store. User confirmed this tradeoff.
'Unit' is hardcoded to 'Pcs' — Amazon MTR reports carry no UOM column, and the reference file uses 'Pcs' for every row.
_meta.separately_flagged_bug: amazonB2BProcessor.js classifies intra/inter-state (for Final CGST/SGST/IGST Tax) using Bill From/To State instead of Ship From/To State, unlike B2C which already uses Ship state. This silently zeroes tax on rows where Bill state differs from Ship state. Confirmed via the reference file. User asked to leave this for a separate task — the x2beta sheet's own Party Ledger/Vch No use Ship-state-based classification (correct), but the underlying Final CGST/SGST/IGST Tax values it displays still come from the existing (Bill-based) computation.

`{CN- if credit note}Sales-{sellerStateAbbr}`, e.g. 'CN-Sales-KA'. Credit note = Final Taxable Sales Value < 0. sellerStateAbbr = 2-letter state code derived from the Seller Gstin's own state prefix.

reconciliation_check: After building the sheet, both processors sum Amount*/Output IGST/Output CGST/Output SGST across all rows and compare against the pivot sheet's Final Taxable Sales Value / Final IGST Tax / Final CGST Tax / Final SGST Tax sums, warning via console.warn if they differ by more than 0.01. This caught a real bug during development (see _meta.separately_flagged_bug) — a mismatch does not necessarily mean the x2beta sheet is wrong; it can also mean the underlying shared computation is wrong, since both sides ultimately read from the same 'Final ...' fields.
